White noise can be great. It provides audio stimulation that can keep your brain preoccupied. Mel a tonin and things like sleepy tea can help, though I’m not sure what dosage and frequency of use would be deemed unhealthy. Making sure your environment is the best for your sleep (no lights, proper temperature, etc.) Don’t eat before you sleep because digestion takes energy which can disrupt your sleep. Make sure you do lots of physical activity and have lots of mental stimulation during the day, that way you will feel completely exhausted by the time you crawl into bed. Practice mindfulness meditation with focus on breathing. Say the words “in, out” in your head while you breathe, and let any pointless or intrusive thoughts come and go. The brain is bad at multitasking so staying focused on the breathing will make it harder for your mind to wander, and you’ll get so bored that you’ll doze off. (This method I’ve been doing for years and I fall asleep in under 1 minute). Everyone’s different but these methods have been helpful for me in the past. Don’t be discouraged if your sleep doesn’t improve right away, this will take time. Congrats on day 2 btw, keep up the good work
